fixtures.claim: the successor begins its journey on the tile the founders physically left from, not at the destination — defect 2 was a daughter appearing 5 and 7 tiles away in a single day
consecutive positions are always exactly one tile apart — the group walks rather than appearing somewhere
world passability is a physical execution constraint on every step, so no position in the whole journey is a tile people cannot occupy
reaching the destination earns only the right to try to live there; `stabilized` still demands lived evidence and is never produced by arriving

the retained trail is the sequence of tiles the group physically left, capped so a long journey cannot grow unbounded state — it is what a return retraces instead of re-deriving a route the group never had
an injured column is slower than a whole one — measured through the CANONICAL `deriveTravelPace` authority rather than a second pace model invented here

with the group held in a non-travel phase, sixty days of ordinary daily actions and seasonal processing move it exactly nowhere — so the position changes above are the travel authority's and nothing else's
two identical departures walk the identical sequence of tiles
no receipt, no storage and no ration appears during the journey — travel subsistence is UNBUILT and is not faked

detail.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: route foraging by the travelling bodies, and a physically debited carried provision stock; both need an authority that does not exist yet and neither is faked here

fixtures.claim: the group's hunger FALLS while it walks with nothing to eat, because its `seasonalSupport` is absent by policy and the canonical nutrition derivation treats absent as unstressed — an unearned improvement produced by a correct reset

detail.mechanism: Band.seasonalSupport is INVALIDATE_UNTIL_LATER_PHASE (absent); all three hungerPressure writers derive it from that support through deriveCanonicalNutritionState, which reads absent as no stress
detail.whyNotRepairedHere: the fix is a travel subsistence authority (route foraging, or a debited carried stock); a hunger floor would be a tuned number standing in for a mechanism
detail.consequence: travel is currently EASIER than standing still, which is the opposite of the interim this pass wanted, and it is the blocking item for the travel-subsistence work
